start.what: Project browser / new-project launcher. Left column = categories, middle = templates of the chosen category, right = details + Project name + Create project.

reach.why: Reuse the open session (tabs stay mounted); only load the page when nothing is open yet.

sel.name: My Projects Open recent or saved work

myProjects.does: Category: saved .chipblocks files (scan + recent list). Needs the Electron bridge to list or open anything.

circuit.does: Category: circuit templates (Blank circuit, LED + resistor, Voltage divider, RC low-pass, Non-inverting amp, Common-emitter amp, Bridge rectifier).

component.does: Category: component starters with demo/bare variants. Selected on launch with no template picked.

sel.name: Board / PCB Place parts, route copper, export Gerbers

board.does: Category: Blank board (opens in the Board workspace).

sel.name: Chip / IC Standard cells, floorplan, timing sign-off

chip.does: Category: Blank chip (opens in the Chip workspace).

tplLed.does: Template: 5 V source, 150 Ω, LED, ground — wired (default name MyLED).

tplDivider.does: Template: 10 V source, 10 kΩ + 10 kΩ (default name MyDivider).

tplBlankBoard.does: Template: empty PCB, initialWorkspace = board (default name MyBoard).

projectName.does: Name for the new tab; auto-suggested per template until edited.

createProject.does: Opens a workspace tab from the chosen template. Disabled until a template is chosen.

openRefusal.does: Why the last open/start attempt was refused (title + reason + Dismiss).

sel.text: Pick a template to see its details.

invariants.why: create() is a no-op without a template, so the button is disabled (project-browser.tsx 'disabled={!template}').

workspace.what: Editor tab: tab bar (⌂ My Projects, <project tab>, ×), breadcrumb Circuit ▸ Board ▸ Chip ▸ System · soon, React Flow canvas (role=application), status line, dock panels (Hierarchy/Properties/Network overview/Tools…), toolbar.

homeTab.does: Back to the start screen (project tabs stay mounted, hidden).

testsPreflight.does: Opens the Simulation test bench (saved checks run on independent copies).

connect.does: Auto-routed wire between two clicked dots.

solve.does: Run the physics now (matters when Always on is off).

addPart.does: Opens the searchable part picker (Choose a part).

scope.does: Transient run + waveform panel (probe by clicking dots).

pcb.does: Toggles the PCB dock panel (placement summary, Export ZIP, Check Gerbers, board view).

math.does: Every equation behind the solve, KCL re-summed per net.

group.does: Group selection into a block; disabled with nothing selected.

tab.does: The project's tab (name from Project name).

closeTab.does: Close a project tab (title 'Close project'). First visible one when several are open.

focusCanvas.does: The status line is a pointer-events:none overlay at the bottom of the canvas: a mouse click at its spot lands on empty canvas, giving the editor keyboard focus without selecting anything (used before keyboard shortcuts).

invariants.why: Status line (data-testid=status-line) always reports counts.
System is a placeholder.
Nothing to group on an empty canvas.

laya.q: Is a crash or error message visible?
Is the canvas empty, with 0 components?

math.what: The math behind this circuit — recomputed from the live solve: MNA step text with 'converged: yes|no', per-part laws with real numbers, KCL proof net by net ('… balanced'). Root carries data-testid=math-panel and data-converged=true|false.

invariants.name: data-converged
invariants.why: A circuit the canvas shows as solved must have a converged Newton solve (math-panel data-converged).
Every net's current sum is recomputed; a net shows '⚠ NOT balanced' when it fails (math-panel.tsx 116).

testBench.what: Simulation test bench (Tests and preflight): Create a check (Name, Analysis, Device terminal, Quantity, Expected value, Absolute tolerance, Reference or formula, Save check), Saved tests (n) with Run/Advanced/Remove, last-run snapshot headings '<name>: PASS|FAIL'.

reference.does: Independent reference (required by the bench's honesty rule).

invariants.why: Bench promises not to touch the live circuit.

laya.q: Does the latest test result say PASS?

partPicker.what: Choose a part — modal (role=dialog 'Choose a part') listing every part, grouped under section headers (data-testid=part-picker-section) when the search box is empty; aria-live count '<n> parts' or '<k> of <n>'.

search.does: Fuzzy search; Enter places the selected row.

list.does: Options are parts; headers are plain text (not selectable).

place.does: Drop the selected part at the view centre.

sections.does: Section header rows (shown only while the search box is empty).

invariants.why: aria-live count is always present.

laya.q: Is the part list grouped into sections such as Passives and Transistors?

pcbPanel.what: PCB dock panel: summary '<n> parts placed · W × H mm board[ · a of b connections routed][ · vias][ · pins not on board][ · DRC clean | DRC: n violations][ · over-current not checked]', Export ZIP / Check Gerbers / Close, export note, Gerber check, board view (Flat/Layers/3D) + stack-up controls. Hooks: pcb-summary (data-placed/data-routed/data-drc), pcb-export-zip, pcb-check-gerbers, pcb-export-note.

exportZip.does: Builds + validates the manufacturing ZIP, then window.chipblocks.saveFabZip. Disabled while pcbFabProblems is non-empty; the title lists why.

summary.does: Summary span; data-placed / data-routed / data-drc carry the counts.

invariants.why: disabled={pcbFabProblems.length > 0} and the title is built from the same list.
DRC violations are in pcbFabProblems.
Unrouted connections are in pcbFabProblems.
'no parts on the board' is a fab problem.
Routed can never exceed total.
data-drc and the visible prose come from the same pcbDrc list.

laya.q: Is the Export ZIP button disabled?
Are all of the board's connections routed?

gerberCheck.what: Gerber check inside the PCB panel: plots the Gerber + Excellon strings Export ZIP would write. Either (a) Stack + one tab per non-empty file, counts line, legend, notes, − + Fit [Zoom to thinnest line], svg 'Gerber plot' (testid gerber-plot); or (b) refusal 'Not plotted. Part of a file was skipped…' (testid gerber-unplotted) with per-file warnings; or (c) an empty message. Footer lists non-Gerber files.

ready.matches: Gerber check — plots ChipBlocks output only

of.matches: No artwork|No manufacturing files|No holes|No openings

region.anchor: Gerber check — plots ChipBlocks output only

stack.does: All plotted layers in one frame.

tab.does: One file alone (data-testid=gerber-layer-tab, aria-pressed=true when active); the counts line (gerber-counts) shows flashes · strokes · drills · FileFunction · polarity.

plot.does: The svg (role img 'Gerber plot, millimetres, Y down').

invariants.why: A refused file set is never drawn (refused ? banner : plot).

if.matches: Not plotted \(not a Gerber or drill file\)

invariants.why: The footer about README/BOM is informational and appears with any outcome.

laya.q: Does the Gerber check show a 'Not plotted' refusal warning instead of a plot?
Is the Gerber plot drawn, with layer tabs and a plot image shown?

boardWorkspace.what: Board workspace (breadcrumb Board, or Blank board template): header 'Board' + '<n> parts · W × H mm[ · a/b routed][ · DRC: n][ · over-current not checked]', Flat/Layers/3D, Route/Via/Measure/Outline tools, 'PCB layout' svg (only once parts have footprints; an empty board shows 'No parts with footprints on the board yet…').

contentManager.what: Plugin & Content Manager dialog: intro paragraph (honesty notes), trusted-publisher status, registry URL (empty by default — no registry ships), Install from registry, Install from local pack…, status message, 'Installed & catalog' list. Installed rows carry ENABLED / ENABLED · NOT LOADED / DISABLED (content-manager.ts installedPackStatusLabel); catalog rows say PLANNED · NOT INSTALLED. A signed installed pack shows content-manager-publisher-fingerprint, content-manager-trust-state, and content-manager-trust-toggle.

reach.why: Native menu Tools ▸ Plugin & Content Manager → main.tsx re-broadcasts this window event; the runner sends the same event.

install.does: Pick a local pack (Electron bridge). In the browser it shows a 'needs the desktop app bridge' status instead.

registryUrl.does: https index URL the user types. Empty until they set one. Nothing is downloaded by typing.

registryStatus.does: Says no registry is configured when the URL is unset. ChipBlocks does not ship a registry.

installFromRegistry.does: Install the chosen registry pack after hash and signature checks. In the browser it explains the desktop bridge is required.

badges.does: Installed-pack status badge (data-pack=<id>): ENABLED / ENABLED · NOT LOADED / DISABLED. Catalog rows have no testid (PLANNED · NOT INSTALLED text).

invariants.matches: does not download arbitrary remote code
invariants.why: Core honesty claim of the panel.

invariants.matches: No publisher keys ship as trusted
invariants.why: The app must not imply a built-in publisher key.
No registry exists to point at; the empty state must say so.

laya.q: Does a pack show the badge ENABLED · NOT LOADED?
Is at least one content pack installed?

shortcuts.what: Shortcuts & controls panel (role=dialog 'Shortcuts and controls'): one row per action (data-testid=shortcut-row, data-action, data-binding) with Change/cancel; problem line; Reset all to defaults; fixed mouse/tool rows (shortcut-fixed-row). Opens with Ctrl+K in the editor or the chipblocks:shortcuts window event; only the screen on display responds.

changeRow.does: Start/stop capturing a new key for that action's row.

row.does: One rebindable action; data-binding is its current key.

invariants.why: One row per KEYBIND_LABELS action (14 in DEFAULT_KEYBINDS).

errorBoundary.what: Crash panel: role=alert, heading 'Something went wrong rendering the editor', stack <pre>, Try again / Reload. Replaces the whole app.

sel.name: Something went wrong rendering the editor

afterEveryStep.why: Blank white screen = React root unmounted.

benignText.pattern: Not plotted \(not a Gerber or drill file\):[^.]*\.
benignText.why: Lists README.txt, bom.csv, placement.csv, netlist.cir, validation-report.txt, board-job.gbrjob, board-stackup.txt — files that are not artwork. Shown on every good board. NOT the refusal banner ('Not plotted. Part of a file was skipped…', testid gerber-unplotted).
board-B_Paste.gbp / board-B_Silkscreen.gbo are empty when nothing is mounted on the bottom.
Catalog entries that are planned community packs. Different from an installed pack's 'ENABLED · NOT LOADED' (integrity/load problem).

benignText.pattern: Not available as an in-app download[^.]*\.
a malformed or non-sha256 declaration is refused, not treated as "no hash"
A connected wire path does not prove a powered or conducting circuit\.

benignText.why: Warning, not a failure: currents were not solved, so it is not reported as clean.

benignText.pattern: No parts have a footprint yet[^.]*\.
Plated holes are not cut out of this copper image[^.]*\.
This file does not say FilePolarity\.
Expected values need an independent reference; matching a captured result alone does not prove the physics\.
Tests run on independent copies\. They do not change your live circuit\.
so it cannot mark a key as one you pinned\.

consoleBenign.pattern: Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404
consoleBenign.why: The renderer index.html has no favicon; the dev server 404s it. Treated as benign only when every 404 seen is the favicon.

electronOnly.browser: Only the six PLANNED · NOT INSTALLED catalog rows; Install shows a bridge-needed status. The registry URL is empty and the panel says no registry is configured.

electronOnly.feature: Saving rebinds across restarts and the native menu accelerators
electronOnly.browser: Rebinds apply for the session only.

electronOnly.feature: Native menus (File, Edit, View, Settings ▸ Theme/Shortcuts, Tools ▸ Content Manager), saving/opening circuits, netlist/Verilog/GDS/OASIS/LEF/DEF/Liberty export
electronOnly.browser: Not present. The runner reaches the Shortcuts and Content Manager panels through the same window events main.tsx broadcasts.
electronOnly.skip: Native menus and file writes need Electron.
